fact: INSD held a workshop on 27-30 November 2023 in Ziniaré to draw up a data-exchange protocol with the customs directorate, identifying variables and testing a link between the Sydonia database and INSD server to produce foreign trade statistics from customs data.
title: Collecte de données : l'INSD et la douane formalisent leur collaboration dans le cadre de l'élaboration des statistiques du commerce extérieur.
